_doc: The per-stage head table of the packets (G-RENDER, test/shiploop_e2e/render_diff.py): the longest printed text each stage may have, in characters, by case, route, run-directory length and CLI path length (the key 'inline/83/96' is route/run directory/CLI path). render_diff exits non-zero when a stage prints more than its value here or has none. A value changes in the commit that journals the new value (the plan's U1 re-baselines it for the merged branches, U7 sets the allocation); no other unit raises it. The first values are main da9e2e75 (skill-craft 2.5.0 / ShipLoop 1.5.0) rendered by packets.py --offline --text-dir and written by render_diff.py --emit-table DIR --write; they are ceilings, not targets, and a stage over the 20,000-character host cut is journaled as such, not hidden here. Re-measured 2026-10-17 by packet-review unit U5 (one progress block per packet: the narrative at a milestone, else one Where/Next status line; an Improve packet neither; journal docs/experiments/packet-review-2026-10-17/rows/u5-progress.md): Improve packets fall by about 1,300 and most heads by 150-450; step-plan rises where the freed room lets the quoted knowledge stubs and the pause line into the head (inline/83 19,965, ask-agent/163 19,715), and inline/83 validate-existing now fits the 16,000 print limit and prints whole (15,711); every value is under the 20,000 cut.
